documents.title: Gastroenterology Consultation Note
documents.content:
## Patient: Robert

**Date:** 2023-10-27

**HPI:** Mr. Robert presents with acute cholecystitis, evidenced by gallbladder wall thickening, symptomatic cholelithiasis. He reports a history of recent abdominal pain and elevated white blood cell count. Physical exam reveals tenderness to palpation in the right upper quadrant.

**Physical Exam:**  Right upper quadrant tenderness, rebound tenderness present. Bowel sounds are normal. Auscultation reveals bowel sounds diminished.

**Management Plan:** Laparoscopic cholecystectomy performed with successful removal of gallstones and gallbladder wall repair. Antibiotics initiated postoperatively for infection control. Patient monitored closely for complications.

diagnostics.conclusion: Right Upper Quadrant Abdominal Ultrasound abnormal findings: Acute Cholecystitis with symptomatic cholelithiasis. Key indicators: gallbladder wall thickening, cholelithiasis.
